answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com, published 2026-07-01, reporting NN, Inc.'s late-June 2026 announcement; the NN press release itself is not in the records
answer.note: Media report (Yahoo Finance, published 2026-07-01) of NN, Inc.'s late-June 2026 announcement that it is adding 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. As relayed, NN states that 100% of the new capacity is pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and targets US$80–90 million of accretive new business in 2026; both are company statements, not independently verified. For NVDA, this is a supply-chain lead: it points to NVIDIA-rack liquid cooling capacity being built at an Asian supplier, which bears on the supply side of NVIDIA rack cooling. It does not establish NVIDIA as a direct buyer, identify the award counterparties, or show any NVIDIA order or volume. NN's revenue and earnings projections and the Russell Microcap Value Index removal do not bear on NVDA and are not used.
limitations: The award counterparties are not named, so the source does not establish that NVIDIA is the buyer of this capacity; the NVIDIA link rests on the article's framing of the racks.
The 100% pre-sold status and the US$80–90 million 2026 target are NN's own statements, relayed by a media outlet and not verified.
The exact announcement day within late June 2026 is not given, and no NN primary filing or press release is in the records.
No NVIDIA-side disclosure (purchase commitments, supplier list, or rack volumes) is in the records, so the scale of NVIDIA demand served by this capacity is unknown.
The source gives no capacity output, timing of production start, or split between the liquid cooling and legacy automotive lines beyond the stated repurposing.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's primary late-June 2026 press release or 8-K to check whether it names NVIDIA or any other customer for the awards.
Check NVIDIA's latest 10-Q/10-K and supplier disclosures for references to NN, Inc. or liquid cooling suppliers in Asia.
Check later NN filings for the Wuxi line's commissioning date and any customer-level revenue disclosure tied to NVIDIA racks.
